Dozens fall ill at Munger Engineering College

Approximately 50 students and staff at Munger Engineering College reported sudden illness on September 18. Affected individuals complained of stomach pain, vomiting, and headaches. They were subsequently taken to Sadar Hospital for treatment. Around 25 patients are currently receiving care, and their condition is reported to be under control.
